ValidationRule.description: Populate Final Letter Outcome if 'Is Hardship Resolution Letter Sent' is not null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Customer_Complaint", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Non_Customer_Complaint" ), NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL( Type , '4'), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Is_Hardship_Resolution_Letter_Sent__c ))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Is_Hardship_Resolution_Letter_Sent__c,"Related Complaint In-Flight (no action taken)")), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Final_Letter_Outcome__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When "Is Hardship Resolution Letter Sent" is populated " Final Letter Outcome" is mandatory.
